ideas.pitch: A fully self-hosted, Docker-native hackathon lifecycle engine featuring automated scoring normalization, judge assignment, and one-command local setup.
ideas.problem_statement: Registration, team formation, submissions, eligibility, judge assignment, scoring, normalization, results, certificates, and archiving form one complex data pipeline.
ideas.title: RaptorPipe: Zero-Config Hackathon Lifecycle Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core evaluation metric: it actually runs via `docker compose up` with zero external dependencies and processes the exact data pipeline required for production deployment by Hackathon Raptors.

ideas.pitch: An internal scoring normalization engine for hackathon platforms that detects rogue or biased judge scoring distributions and applies z-score normalization across tracks.
ideas.problem_statement: Judge assignment, scoring, normalization, results, certificates, and archiving form one complex data pipeline.
ideas.title: FairScore: Automated Judge Normalization and Anomaly Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact statistical headache every hackathon organizer faces—unfair or skewed judging across panels—using robust data processing algorithms that judges will immediately appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance batch certificate generator and verification archiver that renders cryptographically signed participant and winner assets locally.
ideas.problem_statement: Results, certificates, and archiving form one complex data pipeline.
ideas.title: CertGen Pipeline: Automated Dynamic Credentialing & Archival
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the final, often neglected stage of the hackathon lifecycle, providing a polished and satisfying end-to-end user experience that works offline without cloud storage.

ideas.pitch: A local recommendation and constraint solver that automatically matches solo hackers based on skill profiles and enforces team eligibility rules prior to submission lock.
ideas.problem_statement: Registration, team formation, submissions, and eligibility form one complex data pipeline.
ideas.title: MatchRaptor: Autonomous Team Formation and Eligibility Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced handling of complex relational states and rules engines entirely offline, matching real-world administrative needs of large-scale virtual hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A self-contained integration test harness that seeds fixture data and validates edge cases for hackathon submissions, judging weights, and leaderboard calculations.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a modern, open-source, self-hostable hackathon submission and judging platform that handles this entire lifecycle.
ideas.title: RaptorFixture: Automated Acceptance Test Suite for Hackathon Platforms
ideas.why_it_could_win: By building an exceptional testing and seeding rig alongside the core platform, it proves production-readiness, directly answering the organizers' need for a drop-in replacement tool.
